verses.en: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
verses.pt: Filho meu, se aceitares as minhas palavras, e entesourares contigo os meus mandamentos,
verses.en_web: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you;
verses.en_bbe: My son, if you will take my words to your heart, storing up my laws in your mind;

verses.en: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
verses.pt: para fazeres atento à sabedoria o teu ouvido, e para inclinares o teu coração ao entendimento;
verses.en_web: So as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
verses.en_bbe: So that your ear gives attention to wisdom, and your heart is turned to knowledge;

verses.en: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
verses.pt: sim, se clamares por discernimento, e por entendimento alçares a tua voz;
verses.en_web: Yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
verses.en_bbe: Truly, if you are crying out for good sense, and your request is for knowledge;

verses.en: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
verses.pt: se o buscares como a prata e o procurares como a tesouros escondidos;
verses.en_web: If you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures:
verses.en_bbe: If you are looking for her as for silver, and searching for her as for stored-up wealth;

verses.en: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.pt: então entenderás o temor do Senhor, e acharás o conhecimento de Deus.
verses.en_web: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.en_bbe: Then the fear of the Lord will be clear to you, and knowledge of God will be yours.

verses.en: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
verses.pt: Porque o Senhor dá a sabedoria; da sua boca procedem o conhecimento e o entendimento;
verses.en_web: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord gives wisdom; out of his mouth come knowledge and reason:

verses.en: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
verses.pt: ele reserva a verdadeira sabedoria para os retos; e escudo para os que caminham em integridade,
verses.en_web: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity;
verses.en_bbe: He has salvation stored up for the upright, he is a breastplate to those in whom there is no evil;

verses.en: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
verses.pt: guardando-lhes as veredas da justiça, e preservando o caminho dos seus santos.
verses.en_web: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
verses.en_bbe: He keeps watch on the ways which are right, and takes care of those who have the fear of him.

verses.en: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
verses.pt: Então entenderás a retidão, a justiça, a eqüidade, e todas as boas veredas.
verses.en_web: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
verses.en_bbe: Then you will have knowledge of righteousness and right acting, and upright behaviour, even of every good way.

verses.en: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.pt: Pois a sabedoria entrará no teu coração, e o conhecimento será aprazível à tua alma;
verses.en_web: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
verses.en_bbe: For wisdom will come into your heart, and knowledge will be pleasing to your soul;

verses.en: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
verses.pt: o bom siso te protegerá, e o discernimento e guardará;
verses.en_web: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
verses.en_bbe: Wise purposes will be watching over you, and knowledge will keep you;

verses.en: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
verses.pt: para te livrar do mau caminho, e do homem que diz coisas perversas;
verses.en_web: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things;
verses.en_bbe: Giving you salvation from the evil man, from those whose words are false;

verses.en: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.pt: dos que deixam as veredas da retidão, para andarem pelos caminhos das trevas;
verses.en_web: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.en_bbe: Who give up the way of righteousness, to go by dark roads;

verses.en: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
verses.pt: que se alegram de fazer o mal, e se deleitam nas perversidades dos maus;
verses.en_web: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil;
verses.en_bbe: Who take pleasure in wrongdoing, and have joy in the evil designs of the sinner;

verses.en: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
verses.pt: dos que são tortuosos nas suas veredas; e iníquos nas suas carreiras;
verses.en_web: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths:
verses.en_bbe: Whose ways are not straight, and whose footsteps are turned to evil:

verses.en: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
verses.pt: e para te livrar da mulher estranha, da estrangeira que lisonjeia com suas palavras;
verses.en_web: To deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words;
verses.en_bbe: To take you out of the power of the strange woman, who says smooth words with her tongue;

verses.en: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
verses.pt: a qual abandona o companheiro da sua mocidade e se esquece do concerto do seu Deus;
verses.en_web: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God:
verses.en_bbe: Who is false to the husband of her early years, and does not keep the agreement of her God in mind:

verses.en: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
verses.pt: pois a sua casa se inclina para a morte, e as suas veredas para as sombras.
verses.en_web: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
verses.en_bbe: For her house is on the way down to death; her footsteps go down to the shades:

verses.en: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
verses.pt: Nenhum dos que se dirigirem a ela, tornara a sair, nem retomará as veredas da vida.
verses.en_web: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life:
verses.en_bbe: Those who go to her do not come back again; their feet do not keep in the ways of life:

verses.en: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.pt: Assim andarás pelo caminho dos bons, e guardarás as veredas dos justos.
verses.en_web: that you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.en_bbe: So that you may go in the way of good men, and keep in the footsteps of the upright.

verses.en: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.pt: Porque os retos habitarão a terra, e os íntegros permanecerão nela.
verses.en_web: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
verses.en_bbe: For the upright will be living in the land, and the good will have it for their heritage.

verses.en: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
verses.pt: Mas os ímpios serão exterminados da terra, e dela os aleivosos serão desarraigados.
verses.en_web: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
verses.en_bbe: But sinners will be cut off from the land, and those whose acts are false will be uprooted.
